name: MeasureTheory.Measure.toSphere
type: {E : Type u} → [NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → [MeasurableSpace E] → MeasureTheory.Measure E → MeasureTheory.Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : E) 1)
provides: Constructs a sphere measure from an ambient measure; for finite-dimensional additive Haar measure its total mass is dimension times unit-ball mass, so probability normalization is additional.
type_review: Inspected the complete definition with section parameters, the measurable-set and total-mass proofs, nonzero and finite-measure results under the Haar hypotheses; manually expanded type, not compiled.
